summary: This is a routine 8-K filed by PennantPark Private Income Fund to declare a monthly distribution of $0.15 per share, payable May 28, 2026 to holders of record May 22, 2026. It is an ordinary dividend announcement with no special-situation elements such as acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or restructuring. No terms beyond the distribution amount and dates are provided. The filing does not involve any strategic corporate event or unusual governance action. It falls under Regulation FD disclosure and is not a special situation.
